The '''Yagara system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Hadar sector/Legends|Hadar sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Yagaran aleudrupe plant]],<ref name="FirstContact" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> as well as the origin point of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] team known as the [[Yagaran Four]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /><ref name="Cracken'sRebelOperatives">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Yagara system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
